title: Access new inventory and channel performance reporting in Performance Max campaigns - Google Ads Help - Accelerate with Google US

facts.fact: Google announced that Waze ads inventory is being added to Performance Max for store goals campaigns, letting businesses appear as a 'Promoted Places in Navigation' pin on a user's map.
facts.quote: We’re making it easier for you to reach customers on the go by adding **Waze ads inventory to** [**Performance Max for store goals campaigns**]

facts.fact: Google states that Waze ads inventory in Performance Max for store goals is now fully available to U.S. advertisers.
facts.quote: For U.S. advertisers using PMax for store goals, these ads are now fully available.

facts.fact: Google states that advertisers need no additional setup to use Waze inventory, because Performance Max automatically uses existing assets to optimize for Store Visits, Store Sales, or Local Actions Directions.
facts.quote: The best part? No additional setup is required.

facts.fact: Google plans to expand Waze inventory to markets beyond the U.S. in 2026.
facts.quote: We are planning to expand Waze inventory to additional markets beyond the U.S. in 2026.

facts.fact: Google says that Search partners will be added to the channel performance report, with specific reporting on search partners and channel performance access via manager accounts (MCC) arriving in the coming weeks (no date given).
facts.quote: In the coming weeks, you’ll also be able to get specific reporting on search partners
